description: Three oscillators locked to one clock, each at its own ratio chosen from a scale, with the second and third mixed to one output and the first on its own

params.text: Picks oscillator I's ratio to the incoming clock from the current scale
Picks oscillator II's ratio to the incoming clock from the current scale
Picks oscillator III's ratio to the incoming clock from the current scale
Sets oscillator II's level in the mixed output, -5V to +5V; patching the oscillator II level input takes this knob out of circuit
Multiplies the oscillator III level input by -1 to +1; with nothing patched to that input it reads 5V, so the knob alone sets oscillator III's level from -5V to +5V
Attenuates the II ratio CV input, from nothing at fully counter-clockwise to all of it at fully clockwise
Attenuates the III ratio CV input, from nothing at fully counter-clockwise to all of it at fully clockwise
Steps through oscillator I's waveform: Saw, Square or Triangle
Steps forward through the eight scales: Rhythms, Integers, Open Intervals, Circle of Fifths, Major Arp, Minor Arp, Microtonal and Bohlen-Pierce (Spooky)
Steps through oscillator II's waveform: Saw, Square or Triangle
Switches between Independent Ratios, where each CV input picks its own oscillator's ratio, and II + III and Phase Modulation, where one input moves both and the other becomes a phase modulation input
Steps backward through the eight scales, wrapping round at the start
Steps through oscillator III's waveform: Saw, Square or Triangle
Tapping this sets the tempo the three oscillators lock to, in place of a pulse at the Sync input

inputs.text: Sets oscillator II's level in the mixed output; patched here, it overrides the oscillator II level knob
Sets oscillator III's level in the mixed output, multiplied by the oscillator III level knob; unpatched it reads 5V
Picks oscillator I's ratio, at 384 units of the internal 12-bit control range per volt
Picks oscillator II's ratio, or both II and III together when the CV mapping button is on its second setting, through the II CV scale knob
Picks oscillator III's ratio, or phase-modulates the pair when the CV mapping button is on its second setting, through the III CV scale knob
The clock all three oscillators lock to; each rising edge is measured to work out the tempo
While this is high the oscillator II and III level inputs are frozen at the values they held

outputs.text: Oscillators II and III mixed at their own levels
A 5V gate that fires when a frequency ratio changes
A 5V gate at half the rate of the incoming clock

notes: the A input is normalled to the A knob: with nothing patched the knob sets that voltage, and patching a cable into A takes the knob out of circuit entirely.
the oscillator III level input is normalled to 5V and the III LVL knob multiplies it by -1 to +1. Unpatched it is a -5V to +5V source; patched it attenuverts the cable.
the II + III output carries those two oscillators at the levels set by the II LVL and III LVL controls. Set both to 0V and it goes silent, while oscillator I keeps coming out of its own jack.
nothing is heard until a clock reaches the Sync input or the TAP button is tapped; the three oscillators take their frequency from the measured tempo.
each of the six buttons steps to the next mode when clicked. Hovering one names the mode and its number; right-click and you can type either to jump straight to it.
menu: Optimized — runs the oscillators through the plugin's faster path, which is the setting to leave it on; found under the CPU Mode heading
Direct Port — runs the hardware firmware straight through, which costs more CPU; found under the CPU Mode heading
Select Scale Set File — loads a scale file from disk in place of the one the module ships with
